smaller: Coinbase / COIN — Wall Street's crypto ticket outruns bitcoin
Boeing / BA — The Dubai order spree keeps climbing

why_lead: Nvidia combined a pre-report move (+2.25% to 504.09 USD, +17.30% over 20 sessions) with the market's biggest pending catalyst: its quarterly results, previewed as analysts bullish (n1062) with no outcome yet published (the premature Notebookcheck item is excluded). Attention: Huang net-worth coverage (n1063), the next-Nvidia hunt (n1262), gaming-channel tightness (n0762) and leveraged participation (SOXL +47.53% over 20 sessions). Cross-asset: Microsoft's record after the Altman hire (n1048), Nasdaq 100 +1.19%, Super Micro and Arm gains, 10Y 44 bps lower. Analog is the general crowded-run-up mechanism anchored on Goldman's record hedge-fund crowding note (n1029); smart-money split between Gates/Dalio-linked stakes (n0533) and Burry's short plus AI-hype-cooling (n0619, n0672); breaks from the report, China export rules (n0647, n0242), the 20-session reference and leverage.
why_smaller: Coinbase: +7.12% to 106.10 USD and +37.42% over 20 sessions versus bitcoin's +8.10%, with Riot +8.02%: a crypto-equity leverage narrative named by a headline (n0736), plus Milei-driven bitcoin demand in Argentina (n1155) and momentum calls (n1153); Solana's -7.92%, Binance delistings (n1148) and ETF timing (n1129) supply the break.

Boeing: +4.65% to 217.71 USD and +20.26% over 20 sessions, with newly published airshow tallies after the 2023-11-14 lead (n0665, n2012, n2005): a comeback-with-a-scoreboard material update; supplier contract renegotiation (n2024) and SAS's 737 exit (n2082) supply the break.

Microsoft: material update of the 2023-11-20 lead on newly published evidence: an all-time high after hiring Sam Altman (n1048, n1046, n1338), +2.05% to 377.44 USD: a talent-coup narrative distinct from Nvidia's earnings test; the WSJ's AI-armor critique (n1341) and the +14.61% 20-session run supply the break.
